name: finance_treasury_accounts
view_definition:
SELECT 'bank'::text AS kind,
    finance_bank_accounts.id AS account_id,
    finance_bank_accounts.id AS bank_account_id,
    NULL::uuid AS cash_location_id,
    finance_bank_accounts.short_name AS name_th,
    finance_bank_accounts.short_name AS name_en,
    finance_bank_accounts.bank_name,
    finance_bank_accounts.account_number,
    finance_bank_accounts.is_active
   FROM finance_bank_accounts
  WHERE treasury_can_view(finance_bank_accounts.id, NULL::uuid)
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'cash'::text AS kind,
    finance_cash_locations.id AS account_id,
    NULL::uuid AS bank_account_id,
    finance_cash_locations.id AS cash_location_id,
    finance_cash_locations.name_th,
    finance_cash_locations.name_en,
    NULL::text AS bank_name,
    NULL::text AS account_number,
    finance_cash_locations.is_active
   FROM finance_cash_locations
  WHERE treasury_can_view(NULL::uuid, finance_cash_locations.id);

name: finance_treasury_balances
view_definition:
SELECT a.kind,
    a.account_id,
    a.bank_account_id,
    a.cash_location_id,
    a.name_th,
    a.name_en,
    a.bank_name,
    a.account_number,
    a.is_active,
    COALESCE(o.currency, 'THB'::text) AS currency,
    o.id AS opening_id,
    o.as_of AS opening_as_of,
    o.balance_amount AS opening_amount,
    o.balance_amount + COALESCE(m.inflow, 0::numeric) - COALESCE(m.outflow, 0::numeric) AS system_balance,
    COALESCE(m.inflow, 0::numeric) AS inflow,
    COALESCE(m.outflow, 0::numeric) AS outflow
   FROM finance_treasury_accounts a
     LEFT JOIN finance_account_opening_balances o ON NOT o.bank_account_id IS DISTINCT FROM a.bank_account_id AND NOT o.cash_location_id IS DISTINCT FROM a.cash_location_id AND o.currency = 'THB'::text AND o.status = 'confirmed'::text
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT sum(c.cash_amount) FILTER (WHERE c.direction = 'inflow'::text) AS inflow,
            sum(c.cash_amount) FILTER (WHERE c.direction = 'outflow'::text) AS outflow
           FROM finance_cash_transactions c
          WHERE NOT c.bank_account_id IS DISTINCT FROM a.bank_account_id AND NOT c.cash_location_id IS DISTINCT FROM a.cash_location_id AND c.currency = 'THB'::text AND c.status = 'confirmed'::text AND c.occurred_at > o.as_of) m ON true;
